Autonomous vehicles, commonly known as self-driving cars, operate by combining hardware and software to drive without human help. They use a mix of sensors, cameras, and artificial intelligence to "see" and understand their environment. These systems constantly gather information to spot obstacles, read traffic lights, and make quick decisions on the road. The main goals of this technology are to make driving safer for everyone and to help reduce traffic jams.
